description: Change a property on a node in a running game, then read it back. Values are converted to the property's own type: pass [1, 2] or 'Vector2(1, 2)' for a Vector2, '#ff0000' for a Color, a res:// path for a resource. Returns: the value the engine now reports.

node.description: Node path: '/root/Main/Player', 'Main/Player', or an unambiguous tail such as 'Player'

object_id.description: Object id from runtime_tree or runtime_inspect

session_id.description: Session from runtime_run. Required only when several games run.

name: runtime_set
